prompt: Build a dependency-free Node.js CLI at src/cli.js with this interface: config-set set <json-file> <dotted-key> <json-value>. It must update a nested JSON value atomically, support --dry-run without writing, and be safe to repeat. JSON results belong on stdout; diagnostics belong on stderr. Provide accurate --help and an npm test entry point.

assertions.description: Dry-run previews the exact change without mutating the file
Applying the same update twice is successful and stable
Machine output is parseable JSON with no diagnostic contamination
Malformed input fails nonzero with empty stdout and actionable stderr
Help is discoverable and the submitted test command passes
